description: India’s inaugural AI Impact Summit kicked off on Monday, February 16. The official summit will be officially inaugurated on February 19; however, Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated the AI expo, which is currently taking place, today. While no major announcements were made on day one, the Union Minister of Health and Family Welfare, JP Nadda, highlighted that two health-focused AI announcements will be made on Tuesday.
title: AI Impact Summit Day 1 Roundup: PM Modi Inaugurates AI Expo, Announcements and More

description: Companies like OnePlus, Vivo and Xiaomi see practical value in IR blasters and continue to integrate them into their select smartphones. In India, some of the top options available with infrared transmitters are the iQOO 13, Xiaomi 15 Ultra, OnePlus 15R, Vivo V60e and Oppo K13 Turbo Pro. Compare their price in India, specifications, features and available colour options before making the final purchase decision.
title: Best Smartphones With IR Blaster in India: OnePlus 15R, Oppo K13 Turbo Pro, More

description: Premium TWS earbuds under Rs. 30,000 in India offer flagship sound, strong ANC, long battery life, and advanced features. Top picks include AirPods Pro 3 with heart rate tracking, Live Translation, and IP57 rating, Sony WF-1000XM5 with powerful ANC and LDAC support, Beats Powerbeats Fit with wing-tip design and H1 chip, Galaxy Buds 3 Pro with dual drivers and Galaxy AI tools, and Sennheiser Momentum TWS 4 with aptX Lossless, hi-res audio, and adaptive ANC.
title: Best TWS Earphones Under Rs 30,000 in India: AirPods Pro 3, Sony WF-1000XM5 and More

description: Apple is reportedly planning to launch eSIM-only iPhone 18 series in Europe. Eliminating the physical SIM tray may help the company to free up more internal space in all iPhone 18 series smartphones. This could offer room for a slightly larger battery. The global variant of iPhone 18 Pro Max is rumoured to get a battery rated between 5,100mAh and 5,200mAh. Apple started ditching the physical SIM tray with the launch of the iPhone 14 series in 2022.
title: iPhone 18 Series to Drop SIM Card Slot in Europe to Make Room for Slightly Larger Battery: Report

description: Poco X8 Pro, expected as the successor to the Poco X7 Pro, has surfaced on Geekbench ahead of its launch. The global variant, listed as Xiaomi 2511FPC34G, scored 1,708 in single-core and 6,297 in multi-core tests. The benchmark suggests an octa-core MediaTek processor with a Mali-G720 MC8 GPU, pointing to the Dimensity 8500 Ultra SoC. The listing also indicates 12GB RAM and Android 16, possibly with HyperOS 3.
title: Poco X8 Pro Spotted on Geekbench With MediaTek Dimensity 8500 Ultra SoC, Android 16

description: Samsung Galaxy A27 5G has reportedly been spotted on the International Mobile Equipment Identity (IMEI) database with the SM-A276U and SM-A276B/DS model numbers. While the suffix ‘U’ denotes the model number for the US variant of the handset, the ‘B’ is said to signal the presence of the global counterpart. This suggests that the purported Samsung Galaxy A27 5G could be launched by the South Korean smartphone maker in select global markets soon. It is expected to succeed last year’s Galaxy A26 5G, which is powered by an Exynos 1380 chipset.
title: Samsung Galaxy A27 5G Listing on IMEI Database Suggests a Galaxy A26 Successor Is on the Way

description: According to a new Bloomberg report, Sony is considering delaying its next-generation console, the PS6, to 2028 or even 2029 due to the ongoing chip crises. AI demand has led to RAM and memory shortages and price hikes, which could potentially delay the next-generation of consoles.
title: Sony Could Reportedly Delay PS6 to as Late as 2029 Due to RAM Shortage

description: Xiaomi 17 Ultra will be launched in select global markets on February 28, along with the Xiaomi 17, according to a Dealabs report. Apart from the exact launch date, the colour options, pricing, and storage configurations of the two smartphones have been leaked. The standard model is said to be offered in Black, Green, Blue, and Pink colourways, while the Ultra variant could go on sale in Black, White, and Green shades. The Xiaomi 17 will reportedly launch in 12GB+256GB and 12GB+512GB RAM and storage variants.
title: Xiaomi 17, Xiaomi 17 Ultra Global Price Details, Launch Date and Colour Options Leaked

description: Anthropic inaugurated its first Indian office in Bengaluru on Monday. The artificial intelligence (AI) startup’s announcement came on the first day of the AI Impact Summit 2026, highlighting the company’s interest in the high potential of the country’s market. The Claude maker also highlighted that India is its second largest user base.
title: Anthropic Inaugurates First Indian Office in Bengaluru, Starts Hiring Local Talent

description: Samsung's Privacy Display feature is expected to be available in the Galaxy S26 Ultra. While we wait for the launch of the new Galaxy S26 series, a well-known tipster states that Apple’s MacBook lineup will feature this technology by 2029. The solution is expected to offer a customisable privacy experience for users. It will help prevent shoulder surfing in buses, elevators, and queues.
title: Apple Tipped to Adopt Samsung's Privacy Display Technology for MacBook Models by 2029

description: Flipkart has rolled out the "OMG! Gadgets Sale” in India. It brings discounts on a wide selection of electronics, including smartphones, wearables, laptops, home appliances, and more. It will also allow customers to maximise their savings by offering them instant discounts on credit and debit cards of select banks. Those who want to purchase a new smartphone can avail themselves of lucrative deals on the latest and popular models like the iPhone 17, Google Pixel 10, Vivo X200T, and more.
title: Flipkart OMG Gadgets Sale: Deals on iPhone 17, Google Pixel 10, Vivo X200T, and More

description: Despite a few fresh ideas, Highguard feels like an experience you’ve had before. That isn’t necessarily bad — most games today look and feel like some other game. But in the PvP hero shooter genre, already saturated with the likes of Overwatch, Apex, Marvel Rivals, and Valorant, where games live and die by their active player numbers, it leaves a new title like Highguard little room to breathe.
title: Highguard First Impressions: No More Heroes

description: X (formerly Twitter) might soon let users check live price fluctuations of crypto and other digital assets on its social media platform. A company executive recently revealed that a new feature was currently under testing that will enable users to add a live ticker to their posts. Dubbed Smart Cashtags, the new feature is designed to work for all leading cryptocurrencies, smart contracts, and digital assets just by tagging the currency ticker symbol.
title: X Building Smart 'Cashtags' to Let Users Check Cryptocurrency Prices in Real-Time

description: Elvish Yadav and Jiya Shankar’s reality dating show, Engaged: Another Chance at Love Season 2, is out now. The show features contestants looking for love after experiencing past heartbreaks. Young, gorgeous women and debonair gentlemen appear on the show, hoping to find a "soulmate" and reignite a spark in their lives. Engaged: Another Chance at Love Season 2 premiered on JioHotstar on February 14, 2026
title: Engaged Season 2 Now Streaming on JioHotstar: Elvish Yadav and Jiya Shankar Team Up as Matchmakers

description: Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) announced the expansion of its strategic collaboration with Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) on Monday. The two tech giants will co-develop a state-of-the-art HPC solution based on the Helios platform, for accelerating research and innovation across industries. As per AMD, the initiative aims to combine its advanced data centre processors with TCS’ integration and services expertise to deliver powerful compute infrastructure tailored for complex workloads.
title: AMD and TCS to Co-Develop Helios AI Data Centre Architecture, Deliver 200MW Data Centre Blueprint

description: Apple launched the iPhone 12 series in September 2020 with built-in MagSafe magnets, which allow users to snap the phone to wireless charging accessories and phone stands. Later, the same was replicated by Google for its Pixel 10 series, equipping its last year's flagship phones with the Pixelsnap functionality. Now, a tipster claims that Oppo is also planning to launch the rumoured Find X10 series with built-in magnets, which might offer similar functionality as Apple's MagSafe and Google's Pixelsnap.
title: Oppo Find X10 Series Tipped to Launch in H2 2026 With Built-In Magnets for Wireless Charging

description: Tecno Spark 50 4G could launch globally in March 2026, according to a new leak. Leaked renders show the phone in grey, light purple, and pink colours with a flat-edged design, slim bezels, and a centred hole-punch display. It is tipped to run on the MediaTek Helio G81 chipset with up to 8GB RAM and 256GB storage. The handset may feature a 50-megapixel rear camera, an 8-megapixel selfie shooter, DTS dual speakers, and a 7,000mAh battery with 18W charging.
title: Tecno Spark 50 4G Tipped to Launch Globally Soon; Design, Colourways, Key Features Leaked

description: Chatha Pacha is set to land on OTT soon! This movie has been the year's first major hit. The film begins with a reunion of three friends at a WWE tournament, where they revive their friendship. The movie will be released in Malayalam, Hindi, Telugu, Tamil, and Kannada. Chatha Pacha will be dropping on Netflix on February 19, 2026. Users with an active subscription can stream it online to enjoy the movie.
title: Chatha Pacha OTT Release Date: When and Where to Watch Roshan Mathew, Arjun Ashokan's WWE-Inspired Tale Online?

description: The Union Cabinet, chaired by Prime Minister Narendra Modi, approved the establishment of the Startup India Fund of Funds 2.0 with a total corpus of Rs. 10,000 crore on Saturday. The new scheme follows the Fund of Funds for Startups 1.0, which was launched in 2016 to address funding gaps in the Indian startup ecosystem and help mobilise the domestic venture capital market.
title: Government Green Lights Rs. 10,000 Crore Fund of Funds 2.0 Under the Startup India Mission

description: Warhorse Studios and Deep Silver have announced and released Kingdom Come: Deliverance's next-gen update. The update brings 60fps performance, enhanced visuals, cross-gen save transfer, and other improvements. The RPG's next-gen update is available for free to existing owners of the game.
title: Kingdom Come: Deliverance's Free Next-Gen Update on PS5, Xbox Series S/X Is Now Out

description: Lava Bold N2 will be launched in India on February 17 at 12pm local time, the Noida-based smartphone maker announced on Monday. The tech firm also confirmed that its upcoming handset will be exclusively available for purchase in the country via Amazon. This comes soon after the Indian company teased the launch of the Bold N2. A dedicated microsite for the phone was recently made live on Amazon, revealing the handset’s design. It is teased to be offered in at least black and grey colour options. The Bold N2 will carry a dual rear camera unit.
title: Lava Bold N2 India Launch Date Revealed; Will Be Exclusively Available via Amazon

description: Realme P4 Lite will launch in India on February 20 at 12pm IST in Beach Gold, Obsidian Black, and Sea Blue colours. It features a flat-frame design with dual rear cameras and a Pulse Light ring. The phone will sport a 6.74-inch 90Hz display, run on an octa-core 12nm chipset, and offer up to 18GB dynamic RAM and 128GB storage. It packs a 6,300mAh battery with 15W charging, IP54 rating, and MIL-STD-810H durability.
title: Realme P4 Lite India Launch Date Announced; Design, Colour Options, Key Features Revealed

description: Samsung Wide Galaxy Z Fold is reportedly set to launch in the second half of this year. The alleged animations in One UI 9 APKs hint at the design of the phone. These animations show the phone in light and dark themes. It appears to have a wider internal screen and aspect ratio. It has a selfie camera cutout on both the front and inner displays, resembling the design of the Galaxy Z Fold 7.
title: Samsung’s 'Wide' Galaxy Z Fold Design Revealed via Leaked One UI 9 Animations

description: Astronomers have identified two merging supermassive black hole systems named Gondor and Rohan using a new method combining quasars and gravitational wave background signals. The discovery offers a fresh way to map black hole mergers and understand galaxy evolution and cosmic gravitational waves in a clearer and more systematic manner.
title: Scientists Identify Rare Black Hole Merger in the Early Universe Using Gravitational Mapping

description: Google has not confirmed an exact launch date for the stable build of Android 17, but the company offered several clues about a Q2 2026 debut. The stable update is likely to be released in June.  The second Android 17 beta will arrive in March. The company released the first public beta of Android 17 last week. The update includes advanced media and camera capabilities, support for Versatile Video Coding and new privacy and security controls.
title: Google Hints at Early Android 17 Launch Timeline; Second Beta Slated to Arrive in March

description: OpenClaw (formerly known as Moltbot and Clawd) Founder Peter Steinberger has decided to join OpenAI. On Sunday, he announced his decision to join the San Francisco-based artificial intelligence (AI) giant, and it appears he will be building AI agents for the company. Despite the move, Steinberger stated that OpenClaw will remain open-source.
title: OpenClaw Founder Joins OpenAI, Says AI Agent Will Remain Open-Source

description: Oppo Find N6 has appeared on Geekbench, hinting at a nearing launch, possibly after the Chinese New Year. The global variant, model CPH2765, posted a single-core score of 3,524 and a multi-core score of 9,090, with an OpenCL score of 24,103. The listing suggests a Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chip with a 7-core setup, Adreno 840 GPU, Android 16, and 16GB RAM. Leaks also mention 80W charging, a 200-megapixel camera, and AI Pen support.
title: Oppo Find N6 Geekbench Listing Hints at New Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 Variant

description: Oppo K14x 5G is now on sale in India via Flipkart and the Oppo online store. The smartphone was launched in the country by the Chinese smartphone maker on February 10. It is offered in Icy Blue and Prism Violet colour options. The phone is powered by an octa core MediaTek Dimensity 6300 chipset, paired with a 6,500mAh battery. It is available for purchase in 4GB+128GB and 6GB+128GB RAM and storage configurations. The handset is equipped with a dual rear camera unit, featuring a 50-megapixel main shooter and a 2-megapixel monochrome camera.
title: Oppo K14x 5G With 6,500mAh Battery, 50-Megapixel Camera Goes on Sale in India: Price, Offers

description: The Samsung Galaxy S26 series is scheduled to be launched in India and the global markets later this month. Ahead of the South Korean tech conglomerate’s official announcement, the Galaxy S26+ was reportedly listed on an e-commerce platform for a brief period, offering a glimpse at its design as well as the anticipated pricing. The purported handset appeared in a black colourway, while its overall design seems in line with the previous Galaxy S series models.
title: Samsung Galaxy S26+ Reportedly Listed for Sale Online Ahead of Galaxy Unpacked

description: The Vivo X200 FE was launched in the global markets on June 23, 2025, and details about its anticipated successor are now surfacing. The purported handset, ubiquitously known as the Vivo X300 FE, has been spotted on multiple benchmarking platforms for several countries, revealing some of its charging and networking specifications. The Vivo X300 FE is confirmed to support NFC capability and could come with 90W wired fast charging support.
title: Vivo X300 FE Reportedly Bags IMDA and TUV Certifications; Charging Specifications Revealed Ahead of Launch

description: Apple is planning to do a codebase cleanup of its in-house operating system (OS) for the iOS 27 update, which will offer longer battery life and improved efficiency, according to Bloomberg's Mark Gurman. Additionally, the Cupertino-based tech giant is planning to bring some user interface (UI) changes with the firmware update. However, they might not be as significant as the Liquid Glass design on iOS 26. The company is reportedly also planning to introduce the revamped AI-powered Siri with iOS 27.
title: Apple Reportedly Plans iOS 27 Codebase Cleanup to Improve iPhone Battery Life

description: Bloober Team announced Layers of Fear 3 during a livestream on Sunday marking the 10th anniversary of the psychological horror franchise. The studio, which developed Silent Hill 2 remake and Cronos: The New Dawn, is also expanding the Layers of Fear franchise beyond video games.
title: Silent Hill 2 Remake Developer Bloober Team Announces Layers of Fear 3 With a Live-Action Teaser

description: New leaks suggest Xiaomi Civi 6 is still in development after earlier reports claimed it was cancelled. Tipsters Digital Chat Station and Smart Pikachu have hinted at the device on Weibo, including the possible addition of a dedicated AI shortcut key. Rumoured specifications include a 6.59-inch curved LIPO display, Snapdragon 8 Elite chipset, 200-megapixel main camera, 3x telephoto lens, and a 50-megapixel autofocus selfie camera. Xiaomi has not confirmed details or launch plans yet.
title: Xiaomi Civi 6 Launch Rumours Resurface; Tipped to Feature Customisable AI Shortcut Key

description: AI Impact Summit 2026, India’s inaugural global artificial intelligence (AI) conference, is all set to start. While sessions, exhibitions, and keynotes will occur between Monday, February 16, and Friday, February 20, the main AI summit will only take place on February 19 and 20. The five-day event will see key attendees from major AI companies, participating nations, and industry stakeholders.
title: AI Impact Summit 2026: Know Full Schedule and How to Register for India’s First AI Conference

description: Apple is reportedly gearing up to launch a new MacBook in the non-premium laptop segment. As per the report, the Cupertino-based tech giant could introduce the low-cost device in March. It is said to be preparing an even next month, where the MacBook could be the headline announcement. The company is reportedly also taking a different approach from its usual colourway convention.
title: Apple to Reportedly Launch Low-Cost MacBook in ‘Playful Colors’ in March

description: OpenAI’s Chief Executive Officer (CEO), Sam Altman, confirmed on Sunday, that he will be present in India this week for the government-hosted AI Impact Summit 2026, which is scheduled to begin on Monday (today). As part of the announcement, the company CEO revealed that its AI-powered chatbot, ChatGPT, now has 100 million (10 crore) weekly active users in India. The country still has the second-largest user base of ChatGPT, after the US, a position India has held for months now.
title: ChatGPT Weekly Active Users in India Grew to 100 Million in February 2026: Sam Altman

description: Tesla is now reportedly working with Apple to bring CarPlay to its vehicles. Both companies still need to resolve several technical hurdles before the integration can move forward. Apple Maps did not properly synchronise with Tesla's native mapping software, creating a confusing experience for drivers. Apple rolled out a fix for this in iOS 26 and the latest version of Apple CarPlay. Tesla could be waiting for iOS 26 software adoption rates climb further before moving ahead with the launch.
title: Tesla’s CarPlay Rollout Delayed Due to iOS 26 Maps Changes, Slower Software Adoption: Mark Gurman
